verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a way to choose the region where GA4 stores property data. The EU Measurement Protocol endpoint (region1.google-analytics.com) only controls where data is collected, not where it is stored. The Admin API 'data retention' settings cover how long data is kept, not where. BigQuery export is a separate host-platform capability with no documented location choice. All three are adjacent features and earn no credit toward storage residency.
